desc: Large microbrewery with interiors made of recyclable pallets.
addr: The Pallet , ABV-Artisanal Bier Village Hoodi, ITPL Main Rd, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, India

rev.t: Very beautiful place. The place has some asthetic locations. The food and the options of the food was very good. The staff was friendly and even accepted the feedback that was given on the food. Gentle light music was played which was apt …

Upon researching a couple of reviews online, I ended up visiting this place for the new year eve and liked it a lot. Excellent hospitality, tasty food, wonderful service, and a fair pricing. The buffet was fantastic; since we tried it upon …

Service is pretty bad. The attendant was quite unprofessional. We had to ask multiple times for food to be served. Quite delayed service.
Food quality is also sub-par. Although beer taste is really good & authentic.
The ambience is pretty good. Perfect for enjoying ipl along with your food & beverages.
